title: Confirmation
outcome: A successfully settled payment and valid inventory commitment produce one confirmed booking, with an explicit recoverable exception path whenever confirmation cannot safely complete.
actor: NoorPath confirmation orchestration reacting to authenticated payment settlement, with customer and operator visibility.
modules: Booking owns confirmation state and the confirmed commercial record.
Payments owns the authoritative settled-payment event.
Inventory owns conversion from temporary hold to durable commitment.
Outbox delivery carries cross-module facts without shared-table writes.
routes: Confirmation exception -> Safe customer status and operator recovery queue
acceptance: One authenticated PaymentSettled fact starts confirmation exactly once for the matching booking.
The active hold converts to one durable inventory commitment without overselling.
Booking confirmation is idempotent across event replay, worker restart and duplicate delivery.
A confirmed booking receives an immutable confirmation timestamp and retains the original commercial snapshot.
Payment settlement with an invalid or unavailable inventory transition creates a visible ConfirmationException rather than silently confirming or losing money.
Retries resume from durable state and never create a second commitment or second confirmation.
Out-of-order, foreign or mismatched payment facts are rejected and auditable.
Customer messaging distinguishes payment received, confirmation processing, confirmed and action-required states.
Operators receive only approved recovery commands; no direct state editing or cross-module database bypass is introduced.
Telemetry correlates booking, payment settlement, inventory commitment, outbox message and confirmation outcome.
exclusions: Document upload, visa processing and detailed travel readiness.
Refund execution, chargeback handling and manual financial settlement.
Supplier-side airline or hotel confirmation integrations.
General-purpose workflow engine or distributed saga framework.
Customer support CRM and unrestricted operator database editing.
